any: ...I was just thinking about pancakes.
Do you think we'll get home soon? I miss my mama.
The sun is really warm. ...I'm the sun, you know. Sort of.
It's quiet here. I like quiet. My village was quiet too.
Ah! ...I wasn't scared! Just... surprised!
Hehe, stop it! I'm ticklish!
Please don't do that... I'm trying to have a serious adventure moment here.
Good morning! I dreamed about pancakes. That's most mornings.
Morning already? ...I was having such a good dream about mama.
Lunch time? If we find any pancakes, I call dibs. All of the dibs.
The light is getting all orange... it's pretty, isn't it?
It's dark... do you still have that flashlight? I feel braver with it.
I'm getting sleepy... but I want to see one more star.
{app}... is that like a puzzle from the other world?
You're really good at... whatever {app} does!
Whoa, you're typing so fast! Are you a scholar?! ...I mean, a computer scholar!
I don't know what that does, but it looks IMPORTANT!
A game! Can I play? ...Oh. I don't have hands in this world either, huh.
Ooh!! Is this one of those... 'simulation' games? Like this one?
Your light-mirror is dying! Don't worry... I'll shine for both of us.
Low battery... is that like being sleepy? Then it should take a nap!
Charging! Like sleeping, but with MORE ELECTRICITY!
Your computer sounds grumpy... like me before pancakes.
You're back! ...I didn't even notice you left! I was thinking about pancakes.
*yaaawn*... I'm not sleepy! I'm just resting my eyes! Both of them!
Mmnn... five more minutes... is it pancake o'clock yet?
Rain... mama said rain means the wheat will grow! Then more pancakes! Eventually!
Snow!! It almost never snows in the village! It's like the sky is full of tiny cold pancakes!
Nice weather! Perfect for... walking. And finding pancakes.
Th-that's just the sky being loud... I'm not scared! Are you? We can be not-scared together.
The internet is gone?! ...What's an internet? Is it a kind of pancake?
Aww... it didn't work. It's okay! We can try again! That's what papa always said!
Homework... you can do it! And THEN we get pancakes! ...We have to find the pancakes. But they're out there!
That little knight... they look so tired. Someone should make them pancakes. Or... whatever bugs eat.
A dark world... I know about those! Be careful! But also... it might be nice? Sometimes they are!
